content.scenario: The District Commission wants to establish a consumer mediation cell and needs to prepare a panel of mediators to assist in resolving consumer disputes.
content.outcome: The District Commission shall prepare a panel of mediators on the recommendation of a selection committee consisting of the President and a member of the Commission, to be maintained by the consumer mediation cell.

user_queries: How does the Commission prepare a panel of mediators?
What is the role of the selection committee?
What is the purpose of the consumer mediation cell?
